These test-only shaders preserve native source/output code from checkpoint `542303f`: the water graph, original flame source, and LDR spatial transport. Includes are flattened to keep the reference independent of the new cap. Modular and wall references use the existing independent native Canvas fixture with CPU-decoded normals in `native_2d_source_checks.gd`. Original artwork stays external and unchanged. The flame/water source also runs uncapped in native HDR solely to distinguish its half-float storage precision from cap-specific alpha changes. This is a regression oracle, not another production renderer.
